parrafo_1.es: Roland Custom Cabinets es un taller de carpintería en Port St. Lucie dedicado a gabinetes y muebles empotrados hechos a la medida. Nada de catálogo genérico: cada proyecto se diseña para el espacio del cliente.
parrafo_1.en: Roland Custom Cabinets is a Port St. Lucie cabinet shop dedicated to built-in furniture made to order. No generic catalog pieces: every project is designed for the client's actual space.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes destacan la atención al detalle y la comunicación directa durante todo el proyecto, desde centros de entretenimiento de pared completa hasta vanities de baño y closets de lavandería.
parrafo_2.en: Clients point to the attention to detail and direct communication through every stage, from full-wall entertainment centers to bathroom vanities and laundry room built-ins.

items.quote: We had a custom 20ft long entertainment center built for the great room in our home and we are very pleased with the end result. The professional craftsmanship that went into designing and building this beautiful entertainment center was outstanding.
I am very satisfied with the work performed by Roland Custom Cabinets. Very responsive, meticulous and professional. I highly recommend their services if you need custom cabinetry.
Roland's custom cabinets have crafted two separate kitchens for me within the last 10 years and their quality and services continue to improve with time. Their wood is beautifully finished.
